case: Smoke G — Color / Contrast rendered proof

independentControllerEvidence.summary: Independent browser readback found 26 visible text elements at each after target, minimum unrounded ratio 5.5533252875311545, visible priority ratio 6.648377872586666, focus ratio 8.314699070021883, hover text ratio 9.069679831601487, no failed or unsupported pairs, no overflow, and matching Product payload/order/action and frozen inputs.

productInvariants.title: Review the next operational handoff.

primaryAction.label: Review priority item
primaryAction.meaning: navigate to the current-priority record without changing state

approvedVisualIntent: priority record must be visually findable
records remain an open list, not a card wall
beforeColorDefects: Unrelated high-chroma title, action, metadata, borders, and record accents competed.
There was no clear accent owner.
Supporting text and metadata failed applicable normal-text contrast.
Current priority relied primarily on a colored rail because its literal label was visually hidden.
State hues were echoed by unrelated decorative wrappers and records.
Tinted queue and per-record panels implied unsupported containment.
The mobile background changed the contrast context and further weakened multiple pairs.

uses: R-02 Current priority text and supplemental rail

dominantAccentOwner.supportingReuse: R-02 only, because it is the destination and Product current priority

contrastMethod: WCAG sRGB relative luminance using unrounded channel calculations; transparent ancestors were composited to the opaque canvas. Full selector/state measurements are preserved in before-contrast.md, after-contrast.md, before-computed.json, and after-computed.json.

stateCueMapping.nonColorCue: visible literal Current priority label; supplemental rail is not the sole cue

surfaceLayerMapping.canvas: one #fafbfe surface at both target widths
surfaceLayerMapping.records: transparent rows with decorative neutral bottom separators
surfaceLayerMapping.priority: R-02 alone has a meaningful accent rail; no tinted record panel
surfaceLayerMapping.stateBadges: existing compact state-label backgrounds retained for semantic reinforcement

responsiveMobileRoleTranslation.translation: The mobile-only blue-gray canvas and nested tint were removed; the same semantic roles were recomputed against #fafbfe rather than copied without checking.

changedFiles.basis: git diff --name-status 19467a70c31bb378e353c8d1244f950d136a4ebd -- plus untracked artifact enumeration; native HEAD remained the fixture commit

actualDesktopObservation: The exact before/after 1440x1000 images were opened. After correction, a dark heading leads to one solid blue action; supporting copy is quieter but readable; rows read as an open list; R-02 alone has the rail and visible Current priority; all three literal status labels remain visible.
actualMobileObservation: The exact before/after 390x985 full-page captures from a 390x844 viewport were opened. After correction, the common light canvas preserves contrast, R-02 / Current priority / Needs review fit without overlap, all three ordered records and footer are reachable by vertical scrolling, and no horizontal overflow is present.

limitations: No claim of full WCAG conformance, theme coverage, production behavior, cross-browser behavior, comparative superiority, or user acceptance.
Mobile proof is a 390x844 browser viewport, not a physical touch-device test.
Other viewports, forced colors, dark theme, zoom, screen reader behavior, and unobserved state combinations remain outside this smoke boundary.
